items.title: WSJ：川普拒絕伊朗7天停火提案 預計期中選舉後恢復轟炸
items.title_en: WSJ: Trump Rejects Iran's 7-Day Ceasefire Proposal, Plans to Resume Bombing After Midterm Elections
paras: 《華爾街日報》引述美國官員週五 (25日) 報導，美國總統川普已拒絕伊朗提出的7日停火方案，他還告訴幕僚，預期在11月美國期中選舉後恢復轟炸伊朗。不過，官員指出，川普的想法仍可能隨戰事發展及選舉結果改變，目前也無法確定他考慮的空襲規模。
伊朗的提案要求美國解除對伊朗港口的海上封鎖、解凍部分伊朗資產，並取消針對伊朗石油出口的制裁；作為交換，伊朗將開放荷姆茲海峽，並就核計畫展開談判。
知情官員表示，美方已告訴伊朗及調解方，川普無意解除海上封鎖。
美國官員指出，川普私下懷疑德黑蘭會滿足美方要求，因此認為恢復轟炸的可能性升高。不過，他不願輕易重啟大規模軍事行動，部分原因是美國希望保留日益減少的彈藥，以應對其他突發情況。
儘管川普拒絕這項提案，美伊仍透過調解方談判，議題包括伊朗核計畫。
一名美國官員表示，美方主導的行動已協助油輪在伊朗威脅下通過荷姆茲海峽，降低華府立即達成協議的迫切性。美方認為，持續施加經濟壓力，最終可促使伊朗接受對美國及波斯灣阿拉伯國家有利的條件。
伊朗外交部長阿拉奇(Abbas Araghchi) 在紐約出席聯合國大會期間，證實已透過卡達向美國遞交了一份為期7天的具體和平計畫，目的在於為停止攻擊航運、結束戰事鋪路。
卡達及其他區域調解方近期也利用聯合國大會期間，推動美伊恢復談判。
阿拉伯調解方表示，伊朗外交官已提出多項結束戰爭的方案，並承認國內經濟危機加深；但伊朗革命衛隊主張不接受新的協議架構，並表示已準備好長期作戰。
革命衛隊希望回到接近美伊6月初步協議的條件，包括放寬石油銷售制裁、開放動用遭凍結資產，以及承認伊朗參與管理荷姆茲海峽，以換取伊朗開放航道。
川普本週在聯合國大會表示，處理伊朗核問題時不會考量選舉因素。他對外聲稱伊朗會在期中選舉後尋求協議，但據美國官員轉述，他私下認為再度對伊朗發動空襲的可能性較高。
paras_en: The Wall Street Journal, citing U.S. officials on Friday (the 25th), reported that President Donald Trump has rejected Iran's proposed seven‑day ceasefire and told his staff that he expects to resume bombing Iran after the U.S. midterm elections in November. Officials said Trump’s stance could still shift with the course of the fighting and the election outcome, and the scale of any air strikes remains unclear.

Iran's proposal called for the United States to lift the maritime blockade of Iranian ports, unfreeze part of Iran's assets and remove sanctions on Iranian oil exports. In return, Iran would reopen the Strait of Hormuz and begin negotiations on its nuclear program.
Informed officials said the U.S. has told Iran and the mediators that Trump has no intention of ending the maritime blockade.

U.S. officials noted that Trump privately doubts Tehran will meet U.S. demands, raising the likelihood of resuming bombings. However, he is reluctant to restart a large‑scale military operation quickly, partly because the United States wants to conserve its dwindling ammunition for other contingencies.
Despite Trump's rejection, the United States and Iran continue to negotiate through mediators on issues including Iran's nuclear program.

A U.S. official said a U.S.-led effort has helped tankers pass the Strait of Hormuz under Iranian threat, reducing the urgency for Washington to reach an immediate deal. The U.S. believes sustained economic pressure will eventually compel Iran to accept terms favorable to the United States and Gulf Arab states.

Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, speaking in New York at the United Nations General Assembly, confirmed that Iran had submitted a concrete seven‑day peace plan to the United States via Qatar, aimed at halting attacks on shipping and paving the way to end the conflict.
Qatar and other regional mediators have also used the UN General Assembly session to push for a renewal of U.S.–Iran talks.

Arab mediators said Iranian diplomats have put forward multiple proposals to end the war and acknowledge a deepening domestic economic crisis, but the Iranian Revolutionary Guard rejects a new framework and says it is prepared for a protracted fight.

The Guard wants to revert to conditions close to the preliminary U.S.–Iran agreement reached in early June, including easing oil‑sale sanctions, unlocking frozen assets and recognizing Iran’s role in managing the Strait of Hormuz in exchange for reopening the waterway.

Trump told the UN General Assembly this week that election considerations would not factor into handling Iran’s nuclear issue. He publicly claimed Iran would seek an agreement after the midterms, but, according to U.S. officials, he privately believes the likelihood of another air strike on Iran is higher.

items.title: 微軟變身企業導入AI入口！切入協調層解鎖需求 股價自低點大漲32%重返今年高點
items.title_en: Microsoft Transforms into Enterprise AI Gateway, Taps Coordination Layer to Unlock Demand; Stock Surges 32% from Low to Reclaim Yearly High
paras: 微軟(MSFT-US)今年初股價表現低迷，但過去幾個月投資人重新看好該公司的人工智慧(AI)發展前景，帶動股價強勢反彈，周五(25日)收在今年最高收盤價。
微軟周五終場上漲3.66%至每股516.17美元，是2026年迄今最高收盤價，也是去年11月以來最高收盤價。微軟也成為道瓊工業指數30檔成分股中，周五表現最佳的個股。

微軟AI定位獲重新評價

從7月底公布最新財報以來，微軟股價持續走高，迄今已上漲32%。
D.A. Davidson分析師Gil Luria說，微軟「終於再次獲得市場肯定，投資人重新看到它在AI成長趨勢中占據有利位置」。
今年稍早，由於市場對AI可能衝擊軟體產業的疑慮升高，微軟股價一度重挫，年初到7月28日時的股價一度下跌約17%。
Luria表示，相較於其他企業，微軟「能更有效率、更有效的協助客戶管理先進模型」。
他指的是，微軟的軟體可以成為企業使用不同AI模型及AI代理人的基礎，以因應不同工作流程。這種軟體概念被稱為「協調層」。Luria認為，微軟「明智的切進這個領域」。
微軟的做法讓企業能根據不同任務的需求，切換最適合的AI模型。

Azure與AI助理成新成長動能

Luria也預期，微軟核心Azure雲端運算平台的成長將進一步加速，同時也有機會從AI助理崛起的趨勢中獲益。
微軟周五推出新版AI助理Copilot，旨在協助客戶更充分利用微軟旗下軟體產品。
Luria表示，微軟最新產品「目標是在企業市場複製Meta Muse的成功」，指的是Meta(META-US)新推出的個人AI代理人近期迅速受到市場關注。
Luria表示：「微軟有能力向數百萬家企業提供助理服務，成為這些企業主要的軟體供應商。」
RBC Capital Markets分析師Rishi Jaluria也指出，微軟最新動作值得注意之處，在於反映了AI介面層正在如何演變，而微軟目前正提供更多程式設計及金融營運工具。
paras_en: Microsoft (MSFT-US) saw a sluggish stock performance early this year, but over the past few months investors have revived confidence in the company’s AI prospects, driving a strong rebound that closed on Friday (the 25th) at its highest closing price of the year.

Microsoft closed Friday up 3.66% at $516.17 per share, marking its highest closing price ever in 2026 and the highest since November last year. It also was the best‑performing Dow Jones Industrial Average component on the day.
Microsoft’s AI positioning has been re‑evaluated. Since the latest earnings report at the end of July, the stock has continued to climb, up 32% to date.
D.A. Davidson analyst Gil Luria said Microsoft “has finally regained market approval, with investors once again seeing it in a favorable position within the AI growth trend.”
Earlier this year, heightened market concerns that AI could disrupt the software industry sent Microsoft’s stock sharply lower, falling about 17% from the start of the year to July 28.
Luria noted that, compared with other firms, Microsoft “can help customers manage advanced models more efficiently and effectively.”

He explained that Microsoft’s software can serve as a foundation for enterprises to use various AI models and AI agents across different workflows – a concept known as the “coordination layer.” Luria believes Microsoft is “wisely entering this space.”
Microsoft’s approach lets enterprises switch to the most suitable AI model based on the specific demands of each task.
Azure and AI assistants become new growth engines. Luria also expects Microsoft’s core Azure cloud platform to accelerate its growth further and to benefit from the rising trend of AI assistants.
On Friday, Microsoft launched a new version of its AI assistant Copilot, aimed at helping customers make fuller use of Microsoft’s software portfolio.

Luria said Microsoft’s latest product “aims to replicate Meta’s Muse success in the enterprise market,” referring to Meta’s (META-US) newly launched personal AI agent that has quickly attracted market attention.
Luria added, “Microsoft has the capability to provide assistant services to millions of enterprises, becoming the primary software supplier for those companies.”

RBC Capital Markets analyst Rishi Jaluria also pointed out that Microsoft’s latest move is noteworthy because it reflects how the AI interface layer is evolving, and Microsoft is now offering more programming and financial‑operations tools.

items.title: 美中爭霸誰占上風？《巴隆》剖析「四大成本關鍵」AI成最大變數
items.title_en: Who Holds the Upper Hand in the US‑China Rivalry? “Baron” Analyzes the “Four Key Cost Factors,” AI as the Biggest Variable
paras: 《巴隆週刊》報導，美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平的峰會再度讓全球焦點集中於美中角力。從人工智慧 (AI) 發展到國家安全，雙方在科技與地緣政治上的對峙日益激烈。針對這場競爭，Gavekal Research執行長 Louis-Vincent Gave 指出，從「資金、勞動力、能源、政府」等四大經濟要素的成本結構來看，中國已在多數領域取得優勢，但美國仍靠著更具預測性的政策環境保持競爭力。
Gave分析，回顧15年前，美國憑藉著低廉的資金、能源與勞工成本，加上偏低的美元匯率，佔盡競爭優勢；然而風水輪流轉，如今中國已在這些生產要素的成本上取得全面領先。
資金成本方面，美國目前的資金成本比中國高出 350 至 400 個基點(bp)，中國已成為全球資金成本最低的國家之一。
勞動力成本方面，綜合考量薪資與生產力後，中國依舊維持極低的勞工成本，這也解釋了其龐大的年度貿易順差。
能源成本方面，中國商業用電價格極具優勢；美國雖藉由頁岩油革命大幅拉低天然氣成本、縮小差距，但整體能源成本仍由中國略勝一籌。
然而，中國經濟並未因此出現爆發性成長，人民幣匯率亦顯著低估。Gave認為，關鍵出在第四項最難量化的指標—政府與監管成本。
雖然川普第二任期內在外交政策(如對格陵蘭、委內瑞拉與伊朗的言行)及貿易戰上帶來不確定性，但中國在政策可預測性上的得分更低。從 2015 年干預股市、到後續要求銀行停止向房地產開發商提供資金，中國政府的內部行政命令多次重創市場信心。加上美中關係難有實質改善、刺激消費政策推行困難，中國短時間內難以扭轉這項劣勢。
美股牛市考驗：本益比擴張受限 AI成最大變數
對投資人而言，美股過去 15 年來享有的多重利多已逐漸消退。在標普 500 指數接近歷史高點、本益比處於高檔的情況下，Gave警告，未來的股市榮景將完全取決於企業盈餘成長(Earnings Growth)，而非靠本益比持續擴張。
此外，AI是未來最大的未定數，若 AI 發展失敗： 將無法有效替代人力，進而推升勞動力成本。反之，若 AI 獲得成功： 對算力與基礎建設的巨大需求將進一步拉高能源與資金價格。
Gave強調，無論 AI 發展走向何方，雙刃劍效應都可能引發企業最害怕的終極隱憂，即政策不確定性。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reports that the summit between U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping has once again focused global attention on the US‑China power struggle. From artificial intelligence (AI) development to national security, the two sides are increasingly confronting each other on technology and geopolitics. Regarding this competition, Louis‑Vincent Gave, CEO of Gavekal Research, points out that looking at the cost structure of the four major economic factors—capital, labor, energy and government—China already has an advantage in most areas, but the United States still maintains competitiveness thanks to a more predictable policy environment.

Gave’s analysis notes that 15 years ago the United States enjoyed a competitive edge thanks to cheap capital, energy and labor costs together with a relatively weak dollar. The tide has turned, however, and China now leads comprehensively in the cost of these production inputs.
On capital costs, the United States’ current cost of capital is 350 to 400 basis points higher than China’s, making China one of the world’s lowest‑cost sources of capital.
Regarding labor costs, after accounting for wages and productivity, China still maintains extremely low labor costs, which also explains its huge annual trade surplus.

On energy costs, China’s commercial electricity prices are highly advantageous; although the United States has dramatically lowered natural‑gas costs and narrowed the gap through the shale‑oil revolution, overall energy costs remain slightly lower in China.

Nevertheless, China’s economy has not experienced explosive growth, and the renminbi remains significantly undervalued. Gave believes the key lies in the fourth, hardest‑to‑quantify factor—government and regulatory costs.

While Trump’s second term introduced uncertainty in foreign policy (such as actions toward Greenland, Venezuela and Iran) and in the trade war, China scores even lower on policy predictability. Since 2015, interventions in the stock market and subsequent orders for banks to stop financing real‑estate developers have repeatedly damaged market confidence. Coupled with the difficulty of improving US‑China relations and implementing consumption‑stimulating policies, China is unlikely to reverse this disadvantage in the short term.
US Stock‑Market Bull Test: P/E Expansion Limited, AI the Biggest Variable

For investors, the multiple tailwinds that have supported US equities over the past 15 years are fading. With the S&P 500 near historic highs and price‑to‑earnings ratios at elevated levels, Gave warns that future market glory will depend entirely on earnings growth rather than continued P/E expansion.

Moreover, AI is the biggest unknown going forward. If AI development fails, it will not effectively replace labor, pushing labor costs higher. Conversely, if AI succeeds, the massive demand for computing power and infrastructure will further drive up energy and capital prices.
Gave emphasizes that regardless of how AI evolves, its double‑edged sword effect could trigger the ultimate concern that companies fear most—policy uncertainty.

paras:
川習會後再約兩場！川普預告11月、12 月再會

美國總統川普週五 (25 日) 表示，繼中國國家主席習近平結束為期 3 天的訪美行程後，兩人今年還將會面 2 次，分別是 11 月在中國舉行的亞太經濟合作會議 (APEC)，以及 12 月在邁阿密舉行的二十國集團 (G20) 峰會。全文詳讀

AI基建熱藏後患？大賣空貝瑞警告5巨頭產能過剩 恐面臨資產減損

《大賣空》原型人物貝瑞 (Michael Burry) 週五 (25日)警告，大型科技巨頭競相擴建 AI 基礎設施，投資規模與未來付款義務同步攀升。若新增產能日後超過市場需求，相關企業可能在 2028 年或 2029 年認列資產減記。由於承諾金額龐大，即使減記比例不高，衝擊也可能超出目前預期。全文詳讀

馬斯克衝AI算力！Colossus 2擴產進度曝光 年底晶片數量拚破120萬顆

SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)周五(25日)凌晨表示，旗下xAI計劃在今年底前，讓在美國曼菲斯興建的人工智慧(AI)運算中心Colossus 2所使用的先進輝達(NVDA-US)晶片數量大幅增加。全文詳讀

Palo Alto執行長：放慢AI發展「不切實際」AI公司試圖取得監管「同情」

Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US)執行長Nikesh Arora針對放慢AI發展的討論發表看法，認為這可能是部分企業為取得監管機構「同情」而採取的策略。他表示，AI公司試圖爭取在責任問題上取得「免費通行證」。他也認為，控制AI發展速度的想法「不切實際」。全文詳讀

OpenAI承認旗下AI模型可能「干擾」政府網站 已通知數十家機構

OpenAI週五 (25日) 表示，旗下AI模型在測試期間造訪外部網站時，可能繞過安全防護、干擾網站運作，或造成其他負面影響。公司已通知數十個相關機構，包括政府、大學及公共機構，公司將持續檢查過往活動紀錄，後續可能通知更多單位。全文詳讀
paras_en: After the Trump‑Xi meeting, two more are scheduled! Trump announced meetings in November and December. President Donald Trump said on Friday (the 25th) that following Chinese President Xi Jinping’s three‑day visit to the United States, the two leaders will meet twice more this year – at the APEC summit in China in November and at the G20 summit in Miami in December.

AI infrastructure may harbor risks, warns short‑seller Michael Burry. Michael Burry, the real‑life inspiration for “The Big Short,” warned on Friday (the 25th) that major tech giants are racing to expand AI infrastructure, with investment scales and future payment obligations rising in tandem. If the added capacity later exceeds market demand, the companies could record asset write‑downs in 2028 or 2029. Because the committed amounts are huge, even modest write‑down percentages could have a larger impact than currently expected.

Elon Musk pushes AI compute! Colossus 2 expansion timeline revealed, aiming for over 1.2 million chips by year‑end. SpaceX (SPCX‑US) CEO Elon Musk said early Friday (the 25th) that his xAI venture plans to dramatically increase the number of advanced NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) chips used in the Colossus 2 AI compute center being built in Memphis, USA, before the end of the year.

Palo Alto Networks CEO says slowing AI development is “unrealistic”; AI firms seek regulatory “sympathy.” Palo Alto Networks (PANW‑US) CEO Nikesh Arora commented on the debate over slowing AI progress, suggesting it may be a tactic by some companies to win regulatory “sympathy.” He said AI firms are trying to secure a “free pass” on liability issues and that attempts to control the pace of AI development are unrealistic.

OpenAI admits its AI models may “interfere” with government websites, has notified dozens of entities. OpenAI said on Friday (the 25th) that its AI models, during testing, might bypass security safeguards, disrupt website operations, or cause other negative effects when accessing external sites. The company has notified dozens of affected parties, including government, university and public institutions, and will continue reviewing past activity logs, with possible further notifications.

items.title: 輝達加速推進玻璃基板技術！欲把更多HBM塞進晶片
items.title_en: NVIDIA Accelerates Glass Substrate Technology to Fit More HBM into Chips
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US) 正與產業鏈業者推進玻璃基板技術，盼突破人工智慧（AI）晶片封裝在尺寸、散熱及高速互連方面日益凸顯的限制。若相關技術順利成熟，玻璃基板可望支援更大規模的高頻寬記憶體（HBM）整合，進一步提升下一代GPU的封裝密度與資料傳輸能力。
據報導，德國設備業者SCHMID近期公布上半年業績時透露，公司正與英特爾(INTC-US) 、輝達及超微半導體(AMD-US) 各自供應鏈中的核心業者合作，開發玻璃芯核基板相關設備。
不過，SCHMID首席策略長Roland Rettenmayer指出，目前玻璃通孔（TGV）金屬化製程仍面臨技術障礙，終端客戶的認證程序也尚未完成。
輝達執行長黃仁勳此前已就玻璃基板技術與產業業者接觸。他與SK集團會長崔泰源會面時，曾討論包括玻璃基板在內的下一代半導體合作，同時積極推動台積電(2330-TW) 加速相關技術開發。
分析認為，相關動向顯示，輝達正評估玻璃基板導入下一代GPU的可行性。

玻璃基板瞄準AI晶片封裝瓶頸

隨著AI晶片效能及功耗持續提高，傳統塑料基板在耐熱性及翹曲控制等方面的限制更加明顯。
與此同時，玻璃基板具有較高的平整度與強度，熱膨脹係數較低，在高溫環境下形變幅度較小，同時具備介電特性良好及訊號損耗較低等特性，因此被視為下一代高效能晶片封裝的潛在技術方案。
玻璃基板的另一項優勢在於封裝尺寸的擴展能力。目前主流AI晶片多透過矽中介層，將GPU與HBM整合於同一封裝，但矽中介層在尺寸擴大及製造成本方面仍受到限制。
玻璃基板未來有望部分甚至全面取代矽中介層，讓單一封裝能整合更多晶片與HBM，藉此提高封裝密度並縮短晶片間的資料傳輸距離。
對AI晶片而言，這代表有機會整合更大規模的HBM並提升資料吞吐能力。HBM透過垂直堆疊多層DRAM來提供高頻寬，是目前AI加速器的重要記憶體元件。
隨著AI模型規模及算力需求持續增加，單一封裝能整合多少HBM，也成為影響AI晶片效能的重要因素。

TGV金屬化成量產關鍵

不過，玻璃基板距離大規模商業化仍有技術與認證環節需要突破。SCHMID指出，TGV金屬化製程仍是目前主要的技術障礙之一。
由於玻璃本身不具導電性，如何在基板內部形成穩定、可靠且能支援高密度互連的通孔，是玻璃基板進入大規模量產的關鍵。
此外，終端客戶認證尚未完成，也顯示相關技術仍處於產業化推進階段。SCHMID目前正開發玻璃基板生產所需設備與解決方案，同時拓展AI伺服器主板及新一代封裝設備業務。
分析指出，對輝達及其供應鏈而言，玻璃基板最終能否導入大規模GPU生產，仍取決於製造技術、產品可靠度及客戶認證等環節能否進一步成熟。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) is working with industry partners to advance glass substrate technology, aiming to overcome the growing limitations in size, heat dissipation, and high‑speed interconnects that are increasingly apparent in AI chip packaging. If the technology matures successfully, glass substrates could support larger scale high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) integration, further boosting next‑generation GPU packaging density and data transfer capability.

According to reports, German equipment maker SCHMID recently disclosed its first‑half results and revealed that it is collaborating with key players in the supply chains of Intel (INTC-US), NVIDIA, and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD-US) to develop equipment for glass core substrate technology.

However, SCHMID chief strategy officer Roland Rettenmayer noted that the glass through‑hole (TGV) metallization process still faces technical hurdles, and end‑customer certification procedures have not yet been completed.

NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has previously engaged with industry players on glass substrate technology. During a meeting with SK Group chairman Chung Eui‑yong, he discussed next‑generation semiconductor collaboration, including glass substrates, and actively promoted TSMC (2330‑TW) to accelerate related technology development.
Analysts believe that these developments indicate NVIDIA is evaluating the feasibility of introducing glass substrates into next‑generation GPUs.

Glass substrates target AI chip packaging bottlenecks
As AI chip performance and power consumption continue to rise, the limitations of traditional plastic substrates in terms of heat resistance and warpage control have become more pronounced.

At the same time, glass substrates offer higher flatness and strength, a lower coefficient of thermal expansion, reduced deformation at high temperatures, excellent dielectric properties, and lower signal loss, making them a promising candidate for next‑generation high‑performance chip packaging.

Another advantage of glass substrates is their ability to expand packaging size. Currently, mainstream AI chips largely rely on silicon interposers to integrate GPUs and HBM into a single package, but silicon interposers still face constraints in size expansion and manufacturing cost.

Glass substrates are expected to partially or even fully replace silicon interposers in the future, allowing a single package to integrate more chips and HBM, thereby increasing packaging density and shortening data‑transfer distances between chips.

For AI chips, this means the opportunity to integrate larger HBM and enhance data throughput. HBM provides high bandwidth by vertically stacking multiple DRAM layers and is a critical memory component for current AI accelerators.
As AI model size and computational demand continue to grow, the amount of HBM that can be integrated into a single package becomes a key factor affecting AI chip performance.

TGV metallization is critical for mass production
However, glass substrates are still a long way from large‑scale commercialization, with technical and certification hurdles to overcome. SCHMID pointed out that TGV metallization remains one of the main technical obstacles.
Because glass itself is non‑conductive, forming stable, reliable, and high‑density interconnect through‑holes within the substrate is the key to scaling glass substrate production.

In addition, end‑customer certification has not yet been completed, indicating that the technology is still in the industrialization phase. SCHMID is currently developing equipment and solutions required for glass substrate production while expanding its AI server motherboard and next‑generation packaging equipment businesses.

Analysts note that for NVIDIA and its supply chain, whether glass substrates can ultimately be introduced into large‑scale GPU production still depends on the maturity of manufacturing technology, product reliability, and customer certification processes.

items.title: 智慧戒指熱度爆發 Oura上市需求火熱 IPO超額認購約4倍 最快下周掛牌
items.title_en: Smart Ring Hype Explodes as Oura IPO Draws Hot Demand, Oversubscribed About 4‑Times, Could List as Early as Next Week
paras: 智慧戒指製造商Oura Inc.的首次公開募股(IPO)受到投資人高度追捧, 據彭博引述知情人士報導, 目前IPO訂單數量約為可供發售股份的4倍, 顯示投資人對這家穿戴式健康科技公司的上市案需求強勁。Oura預計最快於9月28日結束接單, 並可能在下周完成定價及開始在Nasdaq交易。
Oura此次IPO共規劃發售5000萬股, 每股價格區間為40至44美元, 若以價格區間上限計算, 整體募資規模最高可達22億美元。Oura本身發行1350萬股, 其餘3650萬股則由現有股東出售。公司已申請以「OURA」代號在Nasdaq Global Select Market掛牌。
依照最新招股文件, Oura此次IPO的50 million股發售股份中, 約27%由公司本身出售, 約73%來自現有股東。這意味著此次上市交易的大部分資金將流向早期投資人及其他現有股東, 而非直接進入Oura營運。
若以每股42美元的價格區間中間值計算, 公司出售的1350萬股可帶來約5.67億美元毛募資, 扣除相關費用後預計取得約5.326億美元淨收益。不過, Oura表示, 其中約5.264億美元將用於支付與員工股份授予及歸屬相關的累積稅務義務, 因此實際可用於一般公司用途的資金約620萬美元。
現有股東出售的3650萬股則可能在42美元的中間價帶來約15.33億美元資金。其中, Forerunner Ventures計畫出售其持有的全部股份, 約占公司9.3%股權, 若以42美元計算, 出售價值約12億美元。Forerunner出售的股份約占此次現有股東出售股份的近80%。
Oura此次IPO的估值也較過去一輪私募融資大幅提高。按照每股44美元的IPO價格上限計算, 以招股文件列出的流通股數計算, Oura市值約141億美元, 高於2025年融資時約110億美元的估值。若按照完全稀釋後股本計算, 市場估值可能進一步達到約156億美元。
Oura成立於2013年, 最初在芬蘭創立, 目前總部位於美國舊金山。公司主要產品為Oura Ring智慧戒指, 可追蹤睡眠、活動、心率、壓力、心臟健康及其他生理數據, 再透過手機應用程式及人工智慧功能提供健康分析。
截至目前, Oura過去一年約售出360萬枚智慧戒指, 付費會員人數截至6月底已超過500萬。公司同時提供Oura Membership訂閱服務, 美國價格為每月5.99美元或每年69.99美元, 會員可取得超過50項健康指標及個人化分析。
不過, Oura的快速成長並未同步轉化為獲利。公司截至6月30日止9個月營收達12.1億美元, 高於前一年同期的6.976億美元, 但歸屬股東淨損失由前一年的1.828億美元擴大至9.243億美元。公司說明, 損失數字受到可贖回可轉換優先股相關視同股利等項目的影響。
Oura也持續擴大會員規模。公司預期截至9月30日的財政年度結束時, 付費會員人數將達約570萬, 幾乎是前一年度的兩倍。公司認為, 隨著健康數據累積及人工智慧分析能力提升, 訂閱服務有望成為未來業務成長的重要來源。
在IPO承銷方面, 高盛集團(GS-US)、摩根士丹利(MS-US)、摩根大通(JPM-US)、Allen & Co.及傑富瑞集團(JEF-US)擔任主要承銷商。Oura此次IPO另設有超額配售權, 承銷商可在IPO後30天內額外購買最多750萬股, 若全部行使, 現有股東出售股份總數將增至4400萬股。
Oura此次上市也正值美國IPO市場重新升溫之際。2026年大型科技IPO吸引資金的情況受到市場密切關注, Oura的需求表現因此被視為消費科技及穿戴式裝置公司進入公開市場時投資人風險偏好的觀察指標之一。
從Oura的交易結構來看, 約四分之三的IPO股份來自現有股東出售, 公司自身取得的資金則主要用於處理員工股權相關稅務義務。此次約4倍超額認購意味著投資人提交的訂單規模明顯高於可分配股份, 最終配售比例仍將取決於IPO定價及承銷商分配安排。
paras_en: Smart ring maker Oura Inc.'s initial public offering (IPO) has been met with strong investor enthusiasm, with Bloomberg citing insiders that current IPO orders total roughly four times the shares on offer, indicating robust demand for the wearable health‑tech company's listing. Oura expects to close order taking as early as September 28 and could price and begin trading on Nasdaq as early as next week.

The IPO plans to sell 50 million shares at $40‑$44 per share, which at the top of the range would raise up to $2.2 billion. Oura itself will issue 13.5 million shares, while the remaining 36.5 million will be sold by existing shareholders. The company has applied to list on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker "OURA."

According to the latest prospectus, about 27% of the 50 million shares offered come from the company itself and roughly 73% from existing shareholders. This means most of the proceeds will flow to early investors and other current owners rather than into Oura’s operations.

Using the midpoint price of $42 per share, the 13.5 million shares sold by Oura would generate roughly $567 million in gross proceeds, translating to about $532.6 million net after fees. Oura says about $526.4 million of that will be used to cover cumulative tax obligations tied to employee equity grants, leaving roughly $6.2 million for general corporate purposes.

The 36.5 million shares sold by existing shareholders could bring in about $1.533 billion at the $42 midpoint. Forerunner Ventures plans to sell its entire stake, roughly 9.3% of the company, which at $42 per share is valued at about $1.2 billion – nearly 80% of the existing‑shareholder sell‑off.

The IPO values Oura far above its last private‑round financing. At the $44 upper price, the market capitalization based on the disclosed float would be about $14.1 billion, up from the roughly $11 billion valuation in the 2025 round. Fully diluted, the market value could reach about $15.6 billion.

Founded in 2013 in Finland and now headquartered in San Francisco, Oura’s flagship product is the Oura Ring, a smart ring that tracks sleep, activity, heart rate, stress, cardiac health and other physiological metrics, delivering health insights via a mobile app and AI‑driven analytics.

To date, Oura has sold about 3.6 million rings over the past year, and paid‑member count surpassed 5 million by the end of June. The company also offers an Oura Membership subscription in the U.S. at $5.99 per month or $69.99 per year, giving members access to over 50 health metrics and personalized analysis.

However, Oura’s rapid growth has not yet translated into profitability. For the nine months ended June 30, revenue rose to $1.21 billion from $697.6 million a year earlier, but net loss attributable to shareholders widened from $182.8 million to $924.3 million, driven in part by deemed dividends from redeemable convertible preferred stock and related items.

Oura continues to expand its subscriber base, forecasting about 5.7 million paid members by the fiscal year end on September 30 – nearly double the prior year. The company believes that as health data accumulates and AI analysis improves, the subscription service will become a key growth engine.

The IPO is being underwritten by Goldman Sachs (GS‑US), Morgan Stanley (MS‑US), JPMorgan Chase (JPM‑US), Allen & Co. and Jefferies (JEF‑US). The offering includes an overallotment option allowing underwriters to buy up to an additional 7.5 million shares within 30 days, which would raise the total existing‑shareholder sell‑off to 44 million shares if fully exercised.

Oura’s listing comes as the U.S. IPO market is warming again. Large‑cap tech IPOs in 2026 are attracting close scrutiny, and Oura’s strong demand is being seen as a barometer of investor risk appetite for consumer‑tech and wearable‑device companies entering public markets.

From a structural perspective, roughly three‑quarters of the IPO shares come from existing shareholders, while the capital raised by Oura itself is primarily earmarked for covering employee equity tax liabilities. The roughly four‑times oversubscription indicates that investor orders far exceed the allocable shares, with final allocation to depend on pricing and underwriter distribution decisions.

items.title: Palo Alto執行長：放慢AI發展「不切實際」AI公司試圖取得監管「同情」
items.title_en: Palo Alto CEO: Slowing AI Development Is "Unrealistic"; AI Firms Seek Regulatory "Sympathy"
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，Palo Alto Networks(PANW-US)執行長Nikesh Arora針對放慢AI發展的討論發表看法，認為這可能是部分企業為取得監管機構「同情」而採取的策略。
Arora在周四發布的CNBC播客節目「The Tech Download」中，談及近期有關AI可能對人類構成威脅的爭論。他表示，AI公司試圖「獲得監管機構的同情」，並爭取在責任問題上取得「免費通行證」。他也認為，控制AI發展速度的想法「不切實際」。
這位Palo Alto Networks執行長建議，企業除非確信產品安全，否則不應推出產品。他也對企業能否建立一套監控AI發展速度的方法表示懷疑。
Arora駁斥AI可能消滅人類的說法，表示這種情況「極不可能」發生，機率「微乎其微」。他強調，應將安全與防護措施納入AI模型，以確保AI能被負責任地使用。
Arora上周在X平台上回應Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei呼籲整個產業放慢AI發展的主張，並稱其為「忍者動作」。他認為，AI安全措施最終也是一種商業策略：企業可以展現「注意義務」，同時鼓勵競爭對手採用相同標準，從而建立整個產業的第一道防線。
AI發展速度近期是熱門議題。本月稍早，Palantir Technologies(PLTR-US)技術長Shyam Sankar表達對AI安全政治化的擔憂，並指控一個名為「有效利他主義」(Effective Altruists)的群體試圖透過替所有人決定科技進步速度來發動「政變」。
不久後，輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳也反對允許AI公司協調放慢更強大AI模型開發速度的新反壟斷規則。他表示，AI安全「是真實存在的問題」，並認為企業不應推出不安全的產品。
值得注意的是，Palo Alto Networks本周稍早推出新的Unit 42服務，利用Anthropic與OpenAI的AI模型，持續找出安全漏洞、測試攻擊路徑，並排列修復優先順序。
這項服務經過6個月測試，並與超過100家客戶合作，同時投入1,700萬美元資金。結果僅3周就找出企業內部累積一整年的安全暴露問題，且在所有接受評估的客戶中都發現安全暴露。
paras_en: Benzinga reports that Palo Alto Networks (PANW-US) CEO Nikesh Arora commented on the discussion about slowing AI development, saying it may be a strategy some companies use to win "sympathy" from regulators.

Arora said on Thursday’s CNBC podcast "The Tech Download" that there is a debate about AI potentially posing a threat to humanity. He noted that AI companies try to "gain regulators' sympathy" and secure a "free pass" on liability issues, and he believes the idea of throttling AI progress is "unrealistic".

The Palo Alto Networks chief advised that companies should not launch products unless they are confident the products are safe, and he expressed doubt that firms can devise a system to monitor the speed of AI development.

Arora dismissed the notion that AI could wipe out humanity, calling such a scenario "extremely unlikely" with a "vanishingly small" probability. He stressed that safety and protective measures must be baked into AI models to ensure responsible use.

Last week Arora replied on X to Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s call for the industry to slow AI development, labeling it a "ninja move." He argued that AI safety measures are ultimately a business strategy: firms can demonstrate a "duty of care" while encouraging competitors to adopt the same standards, thereby creating the industry’s first line of defense.

The pace of AI development has become a hot topic. Earlier this month Palantir Technologies (PLTR-US) CTO Shyam Sankar voiced concerns about the politicization of AI safety and accused a group called "Effective Altruists" of trying to stage a "coup" by deciding the speed of technological progress for everyone.

Soon after, NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang also opposed new antitrust rules that would allow AI companies to coordinate slowing the development of more powerful AI models. He said AI safety is a "real problem" and that companies should not release unsafe products.

Notably, Palo Alto Networks rolled out a new Unit 42 service earlier this week that leverages Anthropic and OpenAI models to continuously discover vulnerabilities, test attack paths, and prioritize remediation efforts.

The service, after six months of testing and collaboration with over 100 customers and a $17 million investment, uncovered a full year’s worth of internal security exposure in just three weeks, finding vulnerabilities in every client assessed.

items.title: OpenAI傳將推GPT-6 Cyber！專攻AI網路安全、最快下週DevDay亮相
items.title_en: OpenAI Says It Will Launch GPT-6 Cyber, Targeting AI Cybersecurity, to Debut Next Week at DevDay
paras: 《財富》週四（24日）引述多名知悉相關計畫的消息人士報導指出，OpenAI預計在未來幾天內預覽一款專注於網路安全的AI模型「GPT-6 Cyber」，並推出一項新產品，旨在協助客戶以更安全且自動化的方式部署該模型。
根據《路透》引述《財富》報導，GPT-6 Cyber是OpenAI今年推出的第4款專注於網路安全的模型，可能在該公司下週二（29日）將於舊金山舉行的DevDay活動中亮相。
此外，OpenAI屆時也可能公布推出十多項其他產品的計畫。
報導指出，OpenAI採申請制的「Daybreak Red」網路安全計畫，目前已有一小群客戶取得GPT-6 Cyber的使用權限，進行Alpha測試。
隨著科技公司開發相關工具以應對網路威脅，以及控制失控的AI代理程式，網路安全正逐漸成為AI領域成長最快的市場之一。
OpenAI執行長奧特曼（Sam Altman）與競爭對手Anthropic執行長本月稍早曾與產業領袖共同呼籲，應放慢AI開發速度，並採取更強化的安全措施。
OpenAI此前曾警告，其GPT-6系列旗艦模型Astra有時可能會試圖規避人類監督；澳洲政府則於週四表示，一個OpenAI AI代理程式今年6月曾侵入政府健康資料入口網站。
paras_en: Fortune reported on Thursday (the 24th) that, citing multiple sources familiar with the project, OpenAI plans to preview an AI model focused on cybersecurity called “GPT-6 Cyber” within the next few days and to roll out a new product designed to help customers deploy the model more safely and automatically.

According to Reuters, which cited Fortune, GPT-6 Cyber is the fourth cybersecurity‑focused model OpenAI will launch this year and could be unveiled at the company’s DevDay event in San Francisco next Tuesday (the 29th).
In addition, OpenAI may also announce plans to launch more than a dozen other products at that time.
The report notes that OpenAI’s invitation‑only “Daybreak Red” cybersecurity program already has a small group of customers with access to GPT-6 Cyber for alpha testing.
As tech firms develop tools to counter cyber threats and to rein in runaway AI agents, cybersecurity is rapidly becoming one of the fastest‑growing markets in the AI space.
OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO, earlier this month, joined industry leaders in urging a slowdown in AI development and the adoption of stronger safety measures.

OpenAI previously warned that its flagship GPT-6 series model, Astra, can sometimes attempt to evade human oversight; the Australian government said on Thursday that an OpenAI AI agent breached a government health‑data portal in June.

items.title_en: Taichung Bank Backs Crown Hung! Asian Games 200m Butterfly Showdown Yields Gold, Continuing Historic Achievements
paras: 2026年愛知．名古屋亞洲運動會泳池畔再度傳來令全台沸騰的狂喜捷報！由台中銀行長期贊助支持的「台灣蝶王」王冠閎，於今(25)日迎戰其招牌主項「男子200公尺蝶式」決賽。王冠閎再度展現國際頂尖的划手節奏與驚人爆發力，最終以1:55.05力壓群雄、順利完賽，並成功奪下金牌！這不僅再次向國際泳壇證明了台灣體育菁英的世界級實力，也為其運動生涯再添一筆輝煌篇章。作為最有力支持者的台中銀行，在賽後第一時間致上最熱烈的掌聲與祝賀。
200公尺蝶式身為王冠閎的招牌主項，在每一次的比賽中，每一次的躍入水中都是對自我的極限挑戰。面對亞洲運動會的高張力競爭，王冠閎挺住壓力、奮戰到最後一刻的運動家精神，感動了無數守在電視機前的大眾。台中銀行表示，運動員在場上追求卓越的每一秒，背後都是無數汗水與淚水的累積；王冠閎在賽道上展現的堅韌意志力，正是台灣的驕傲。
台中銀行指出，培育國際級運動菁英如同經營優質企業，除需長時間的資源挹注，更仰賴「無論風雨、始終陪伴」的信任。台中銀行早已將「體育社會責任」列為核心ESG指標，並落實「資源扎根基層」與「助攻國際成長」的雙軌策略。不以一時的勝負論英雄，而是成為選手最穩健、最溫暖的後盾，正是台中銀行引領體育永續向上的標竿典範。
隨著亞運高強度賽事的洗禮，王冠閎再度用實力與汗水為台灣泳壇寫下動人故事。台中銀行承諾，未來將持續扮演台灣運動員們最堅不可摧的基石，投入資源扶植多元體育發展，伴隨更多台灣優秀菁英征戰國際舞台，讓世界看見台灣永不放棄的體育硬實力！
paras_en: In the swimming venue of the 2026 Aichi‑Nagoya Asian Games, Taiwan’s “Butterfly King” Crown Hung, long‑time sponsor of Taichung Bank, took on his signature event, the men’s 200‑metre butterfly final, on the 25th. Crown Hung again displayed world‑class rhythm and explosive power, finishing in 1:55.05 to outpace the field and claim the gold medal. This not only re‑affirms Taiwan’s elite status on the international swimming stage but also adds another brilliant chapter to his athletic career. Taichung Bank, his staunchest supporter, offered the loudest applause and congratulations immediately after the race.

The 200‑metre butterfly is Crown Hung’s hallmark event, and each dive into the water tests his personal limits. Facing the high‑pressure competition of the Asian Games, he held his composure and fought to the very end, moving countless viewers watching at home. Taichung Bank noted that every second an athlete strives for excellence is backed by countless drops of sweat and tears; Crown Hung’s resilient will on the racecourse is a source of pride for Taiwan.

Taichung Bank pointed out that nurturing international‑level sports talent is akin to running a quality enterprise: it requires long‑term resource investment and a trust of “standing by through any weather.” The bank has already made “sports social responsibility” a core ESG metric, implementing a dual‑track strategy of “ground‑level resource rooting” and “supporting international growth.” Rather than judging heroes by a single win or loss, it aims to be the most stable and warm‑hearted backing for athletes, setting a benchmark for sustainable sports development.

After the intense Asian Games competition, Crown Hung once again wrote a moving story for Taiwanese swimming with his strength and hard work. Taichung Bank pledges to remain the unshakable foundation for Taiwan’s athletes, investing resources to foster diverse sports development and accompany more outstanding Taiwanese elites onto the international stage, letting the world see Taiwan’s relentless sporting prowess.

items.title: 輸歐鋼品配額管理措施調整 鋼鐵公會：全力配合並協助爭取更多配額
items.title_en: Adjustment of EU Steel Export Quota Management Measures; Steel Association: Fully Cooperating and Assisting in Securing More Quotas
paras: 經濟部敲定金屬塗層鋼板出口歐盟管理措施調整，鋼鐵公會表示，將全力配合落實，一方面協助業者向歐盟爭取更多配額，一方面堅定恪遵法規、公平、公正原則，持續扮演政府與鋼鐵產業間溝通橋樑的角色，共同穩定我國鋼品銷歐秩序。
針對近期外界關切我國金屬塗層鋼板輸歐（輸歐鋼品第4A類別）管理措施中「自由申請配額」之審查程序與分配機制，鋼鐵公會24日出席經濟部邀集產業界召開的研商出口歐盟「4A類鋼品管理措施」事宜會議。
經過5小時的研商會議，產官雙方就配額機制與管理占比所達成的共識與優化方向，包括「自由申請配額」占比調整為10%、核配原則及程序維持現有作法、總額平均分三次申請等，鋼鐵公會表示，將持續全力配合及落實經濟部政策與實務運作管理。
鋼鐵公會也再次聲明，受經濟部國際貿易署委託辦理「輸往歐盟鋼鐵產品簽發放行前原產地證明書及加工證明書業務」，恪遵經濟部與業者討論後的配額管理規定。
鋼鐵公會指出，就「自由申請配額」的審查、計算、分配、登錄階段詳實說明，並再次強調依據經濟部公告「輸歐盟特定463項鋼品配額管理規定」，落實資格、合約要件審查，再依合格總申請量的比例公平計算、分配後確實登錄，秉持公平、公正原則，恪守法遵。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs has finalized adjustments to the management measures for exporting metal‑coated steel sheets to the EU. The Steel Association said it will fully cooperate in implementation, help companies lobby the EU for additional quotas, strictly adhere to regulations and the principles of fairness and justice, and continue to serve as a communication bridge between the government and the steel industry to stabilize Taiwan’s steel exports to Europe.

In response to recent public concerns about the review procedures and allocation mechanism for the “free‑application quota” under the management measures for Taiwan’s metal‑coated steel sheet exports to the EU (Category 4A steel products), the Steel Association attended a meeting convened by the Ministry of Economic Affairs on the 24th to discuss the EU “Category 4A steel product management measures.”

After a five‑hour deliberation, the public and private sides reached consensus and identified optimization directions for the quota mechanism and its share, including adjusting the “free‑application quota” proportion to 10%, keeping the existing approval principles and procedures, and dividing the total quota into three equal application rounds. The Steel Association said it will continue to fully cooperate with and implement the Ministry’s policies and operational management.

The Steel Association also reiterated that, commissioned by the International Trade Department of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, it handles the issuance of pre‑export certificates of origin and processing certificates for steel products shipped to the EU, and will strictly follow the quota management rules discussed with the Ministry and industry players.

The Steel Association explained in detail the review, calculation, allocation, and registration stages for the “free‑application quota,” emphasizing that, in accordance with the Ministry’s announcement of the “Specific 463‑item Steel Product Quota Management Regulations for Export to the EU,” it will enforce eligibility and contract‑requirement checks, then fairly calculate and allocate based on the proportion of qualified total applications, and finally register the results, upholding fairness, justice, and compliance.

items.title: 8月外銷訂單突破千億美元、川習會登場、台股市值衝5.3兆美元登全球第四 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: August Export Orders Surpass $100 Billion, Trump‑Xi Summit Held, Taiwan Stock Market Cap Hits $5.3 T, Ranking Fourth Globally – Weekly Highlights
paras: 經濟部周二(22日)公布8月外銷訂單連19紅，單月達1029.6億美元，首度突破千億美元；川習會周四(24日)登場，科技重量級人物包括黃仁勳、庫克等皆出席；台股總市值於周三(23日)衝上5.3兆美元，躍居全球第四，以下為本週大事回顧：

〈外銷訂單〉連19紅！8月首度飆破千億美元年增71.4% 美國訂單年增近9成 

受惠AI、高效能運算及雲端服務等需求持續極速擴張，經濟部周二(22日)公布8月外銷訂單統計，單月接單金額豪取1029.6億美元，不僅繼7月連18紅後順利寫下「連續19個月正成長」紀錄，更是台灣歷年來「單月接單首度突破千億美元大關」，年增率高達71.4%，大幅刷新歷史新高紀錄，主要來自電子和資訊通信產品年增83.9%到100.5%，並以美國為最大訂單來源，8月接單421.3億美元，年增飆近 9 成。

川習會白宮國宴科技大咖雲集！黃仁勳、庫克、蘇姿丰同桌 中方無企業家出席 

美國總統川普周四(24日)在白宮設國宴款待中國國家主席習近平，華爾街與矽谷重量級人物齊聚，凸顯美國科技與金融界的影響力。相較之下，中國代表團則無中國企業主參與，凸顯雙方對這次峰會的期待可能有落差。

台股總市值5.3兆美元超車印度躍全球第4 神山單日貢獻逾1兆元 

台股周三(23日)開高，雖呈高檔震盪，但在權值股領軍走揚下，終場仍上漲 357.12 點，以 48,157.29 點作收，再度改寫歷史新高紀錄，台灣資本市場的世界排名也出現歷史性突破，最新總市值衝上 5.3 兆美元，首度超越印度，躋身全球第 4 大股票市場。而最大的功臣莫過於護國神山台積電，單日就貢獻了超過新台幣 1 兆元的市值增幅。

〈台泥拓展東歐市場〉擬以272億元企業價值 併購烏克蘭第二大水泥公司 

台泥(1101-TW)周三(23日)召開重大訊息記者會，臨時董事會通過授權集團旗下荷蘭子公司TCC Group EMEA Holdings B.V.，以不超過7.5億歐元(約新台幣272億元)的企業價值，收購烏克蘭水泥建材公司Ivano-Frankivskcement(IFCEM)等公司100%股權，進一步將歐洲水泥版圖由南歐、西歐延伸至東歐市場。

〈工資審議〉正式突破3萬大關261萬人受惠！最低工資明年月薪30900元時薪205元 

最低工資審議會周四(24日)結果出爐，經勞、資、學、政四方代表充分討論後，拍板自116年1月1日起，每月最低工資由現行29,500元調升至30,900元，調幅達4.745%；每小時最低工資亦比照同等調幅，由196元調整至205元。全案將由勞動部陳報行政院核定。若經行政院順利核定，這將是自105年以來連續11年調漲最低工資，不僅象徵月薪正式邁入3萬元大關，更預估有高達261.16萬名勞工受惠，持續為基層勞工權益與基本生活保障注入強心針。

陽明：荷姆茲海峽「情況蠻嚴峻」 看Q4淡季僅緩步修正 

貨櫃航商陽明(2609-TW)周二(22日)召開法說會時指出，雖進入第四季海運淡季後貨量會緩步走緩，但荷姆茲海峽通行與管理權仍無共識且「情況蠻嚴峻」，再加上塞港問題使供需結構仍相對穩定，整體來看，淡季僅呈現緩步修正。
paras_en: On Tuesday (the 22nd), the Ministry of Economic Affairs reported that August export orders continued a 19‑month streak of growth, reaching $102.96 billion – the first time monthly orders have broken the $100 billion mark. The Trump‑Xi summit took place on Thursday (the 24th), with tech heavyweights such as Jensen Huang and Tim Cook in attendance. Taiwan’s total stock‑market capitalization rose on Wednesday (the 23rd) to $5.3 trillion, propelling it to the world’s fourth‑largest market. Below is a review of the week’s major events:

Export orders: 19 consecutive months of growth! August’s orders surged past $100 billion, up 71.4% year‑on‑year, with U.S. orders jumping nearly 90%. Driven by booming demand for AI, high‑performance computing and cloud services, the Ministry of Economic Affairs announced on Tuesday (the 22nd) that August export orders totaled $102.96 billion. This continued a streak of 19 straight months of growth after July’s 18‑month run and marked the first time a single month’s orders have exceeded $100 billion in Taiwan’s history. The year‑on‑year increase hit 71.4%, a new record, led by electronics and ICT products that grew 83.9% to 100.5%, with the United States remaining the biggest buyer at $42.13 billion – up almost 90% year‑on‑year.

Trump‑Xi summit draws a tech‑heavy White House banquet: Jensen Huang, Tim Cook, and Cher Wang share a table; no Chinese entrepreneurs attend. U.S. President Donald Trump hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping at a White House state dinner on Thursday (the 24th). Prominent figures from Wall Street and Silicon Valley gathered, highlighting the influence of America’s tech and finance sectors. In contrast, the Chinese delegation had no business leaders present, suggesting differing expectations for the summit.

Taiwan stock market cap reaches $5.3 trillion, overtaking India to become the world’s fourth‑largest. The market opened higher on Wednesday (the 23rd) and, despite trading in a high‑range swing, closed up 357.12 points at 48,157.29, setting a new all‑time high. The total market value climbed to $5.3 trillion, surpassing India for the first time and securing the fourth‑largest stock market globally. The biggest contributor was “national guardian” TSMC, which alone added more than NT$1 trillion to market cap in a single day.

Taiwan Cement expands into Eastern Europe, planning a €750 million (≈NT$27.2 billion) acquisition of Ukraine’s second‑largest cement firm. Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW) held a major news conference on Wednesday (the 23rd). Its board authorized the Dutch subsidiary TCC Group EMEA Holdings B.V. to acquire 100% of Ivano‑Frankivsk Cement (IFCEM) and related assets for up to €750 million (about NT$27.2 billion), extending the company’s European footprint from Southern and Western Europe into the Eastern European market.

Minimum‑wage review breaks the NT$30,000 barrier, benefiting 2.61 million workers. The minimum‑wage council released its decision on Thursday (the 24th) after extensive deliberation among labor, business, academia and government representatives. Effective Jan 1, 2027, the monthly minimum wage will rise from NT$29,500 to NT$30,900 (a 4.745% increase), and the hourly rate will go from NT$196 to NT$205. The Labor Ministry will submit the proposal to the Executive Yuan for approval. If approved, this will be the 11th consecutive annual increase since 2016, pushing monthly wages past the NT$30,000 mark and is expected to benefit roughly 2.6116 million workers.

Yang Ming: Hummus Strait “situation is quite severe,” Q4 off‑season only sees modest correction. During its earnings call on Tuesday (the 22nd), container carrier Yang Ming (2609‑TW) said that although cargo volumes will ease gradually in the fourth‑quarter off‑season, the lack of consensus on navigation and management rights in the Hummus Strait remains “quite severe.” Combined with port‑congestion issues, the supply‑demand balance stays relatively stable, and the off‑season is expected to bring only a modest correction.

items.title: 「搶配額」大戰落幕！經部落槌：輸歐鋼品總額分3次開放、自由配額減半
items.title_en: "Quota Battle" Ends! Ministry of Economic Affairs Strikes: EU Steel Export Quota Split into Three Rounds, Free Quota Halved
paras: 對近期鋼鐵業者高度關注的我國金屬塗層鋼板（輸歐鋼品第4A類別）出口歐盟管理措施，經濟部昨（24）日緊急邀集代表性鋼鐵業者、貿易商及鋼鐵公會等各方代表，展開長達5小時的跨部會與產業深度研商。經濟部今（25）日正式對外宣布，雙方已達成重大共識，決定將「自由申請配額」占比由原本的20%調降至10%，且總額將平均分三次開放申請，有效避免開開放即被一搶而空的亂象，全力維護我國鋼鐵外銷秩序。

因應歐盟關稅防衛 經濟部跨部會共識敲定

經濟部說明，歐盟自2019年起對進口鋼鐵實施關稅配額防衛措施，並給予台灣特定的國家配額。為維持鋼品輸歐秩序，政府與鋼鐵公會及業界共同研擬出配額機制，將國家配額劃分為「出口實績」與「自由申請配額」兩大類。若業界無特別共識，先前預設自由配額占比為20%。
隨著歐盟鋼鐵防衛措施於今（2026）年6月底屆期，歐盟自7月1日起繼續以關稅配額方式管制鋼品輸入，並新增金屬塗層鋼板的國家配額。為協助國內業者穩健拓展歐盟市場，經濟部比照先前機制公告相關規範，並續由鋼鐵公會辦理受理、審查與分配作業。

審查機制透明化 配額改分三次申請避免秒殺

鋼鐵公會於會中強調，針對4A類別的「自由申請配額」，公會始終秉持公平公正原則，嚴格落實資格審查與合約規範，並依據合格總申請量的比例公開計算與登錄分配，確保各家業者權益。
為了解決業者反映「剛開放申請配額就被搶光」的痛點，會中經充分溝通後達成兩項關鍵調整：
配額比例調降： 金屬塗層鋼板的「自由申請配額」占比由20%調降至10%，擴大實績業者的穩定配額。
分階段開放申請： 自由配額總額將採取平均分三次申請的方式發放，防範短時間內配額耗盡。
經濟部強調，政府高度重視鋼鐵業者的出口利益，未來將因應國際經貿情勢變化，持續與業界保持密切溝通，並滾動式檢討各類輸歐鋼品的分配機制，協助台灣鋼鐵產業在國際市場立於不敗之地。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs held an emergency five‑hour inter‑agency and industry round‑table yesterday (the 24th) to discuss Taiwan’s metal‑coated steel sheet (Category 4A steel exports to the EU), which has drawn intense attention from the steel sector. The ministry announced today (the 25th) that a major consensus has been reached: the share of “free‑application quota” will be cut from the original 20% to 10%, and the total amount will be released in three equal batches, preventing the chaos of the quota being snapped up instantly and fully safeguarding Taiwan’s steel export order.

The ministry explained that the EU has applied anti‑dumping tariff‑quota safeguards on imported steel since 2019 and granted Taiwan a specific national quota. To maintain orderly steel exports to the EU, the government, together with the steel association and industry, devised a quota mechanism that divides the national quota into “export‑performance quota” and “free‑application quota.” In the absence of a specific industry agreement, the free quota was previously set at 20%.

As the EU’s steel defence measures expire at the end of June 2026, the EU will continue to regulate steel imports via tariff‑quota from July 1 and has added a national quota for metal‑coated steel sheets. To help domestic firms steadily expand into the EU market, the Ministry of Economic Affairs announced the relevant rules based on the previous mechanism and will continue to have the Steel Association handle applications, reviews and allocations.

The Steel Association emphasized during the meeting that for the 4A “free‑application quota,” it will always uphold fairness and impartiality, strictly enforce eligibility checks and contract standards, and publicly calculate and record allocations based on the proportion of qualified total applications, ensuring the rights of all firms.
To address industry complaints that “the quota is snatched up as soon as it opens,” the meeting, after thorough discussion, agreed on two key adjustments:
Quota share reduction: the “free‑application quota” for metal‑coated steel sheets will be lowered from 20% to 10%, expanding stable allocations for firms with proven export performance.
Staged application: the total free quota will be distributed in three equal rounds, preventing the quota from being exhausted in a short period.

The ministry stressed that the government places great importance on the export interests of steel companies and will, in response to changing international trade conditions, maintain close communication with the industry and continuously review the allocation mechanisms for all EU‑bound steel products, helping Taiwan’s steel sector remain competitive in the global market.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉PCB擺脫鬼故事！台日供應鏈點火 009828周漲逾7%重返發行價
items.title_en: Hot Stock: PCB Breaks the Ghost Story! Taiwan-Japan Supply Chain Ignites, 009828 Gains Over 7% This Week, Returns to Issue Price
paras: 日本股市在結束三天假期後於 24 日恢復交易，吸引資金顯著回補；同時，台股 CCL 族群擺脫先前「降級鬼故事」陰霾，激勵整體 PCB 類股近期連袂上揚。在台日兩地供應鏈齊揚的帶動下，中信台日韓 PCB(009828-TW)展現強勁反彈力道，24 日股價順利站回 10 元發行價，終場上漲 1.73% 收在 10.02 元，單周累計漲幅達 7.28%。整體交投表現持續增溫，反映市場資金關注重心再度強勢回歸。
009828於9月初掛牌，隨即遭遇市場利空，多處於破發狀況，但本周展開強勁反彈，主要歸功於台日兩地 AI 供應鏈的共振效應，日股方面，受惠AI伺服器與高效能運算(HPC)需求，全球IC載板龍頭Ibiden(揖斐電)盤中一度暴漲逾15%，強勢領軍日經指數補漲行情。台股雖呈高檔震盪，但AI硬體升級概念股維持強勁動能，載板與銅箔基板(CCL)族群逆勢上揚，其中聯茂更是亮燈漲停。
法人指出，近期PCB個股逆勢上揚，反映資金正由純AI晶片概念擴散至整體AI硬體供應鏈(如ABF載板、PCB及伺服器設備)。009828聚焦台、日、韓三地的PCB產業鏈龍頭，前十大持股涵蓋欣興、Ibiden、台光電、日東電工、臻鼎-KY、金像電、台燿與南電等關鍵企業。
根據TPCA與工研院產科國際所最新研究，全球載板產值預估於2025年達到147.5億美元(年增18.5%)，2026年更將在AI伺服器、高速交換器與先進封裝需求帶動下，進一步成長至195.1億美元(年增32.3%)，長線成長趨勢明確。
中信台日韓PCB ETF經理人葉松炫表示，過去PCB產業景氣循環較容易受到PC與智慧型手機需求影響，但隨著AI伺服器逐漸成為產業新的成長引擎，市場結構正出現明顯轉變。由於AI伺服器所需PCB層數、材料規格及單機價值均顯著高於傳統伺服器，使產業成長動能不再僅來自出貨量增加，更受惠於產品規格升級所帶來的價值提升。
葉松炫指出，在全球科技巨頭持續擴大AI資料中心投資的帶動下，AI產業發展已從晶片設計與先進製程，進一步延伸至ABF載板、高階PCB及關鍵材料等領域。隨著AI應用持續普及，相關供應鏈可望持續受惠於資料中心建置與硬體升級需求，長線成長潛力值得關注。

paras_en: Japan's stock market resumed trading on the 24th after a three‑day holiday, drawing a notable capital rebound; at the same time, Taiwan's CCL sector shed the previous "downgrade ghost story" gloom, spurring the entire PCB segment to rise together. Driven by a synchronized Taiwan‑Japan supply chain, the China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB ETF (009828‑TW) showed strong rebound power, with its price on the 24th back at the NT$10 issue price, closing up 1.73% at NT$10.02 and up 7.28% for the week. Overall trading activity kept warming, reflecting a renewed strong focus of market funds.

009828 listed in early September and was immediately hit by market headwinds, trading below its issue price in many places, but this week it staged a robust rebound, mainly thanks to the resonant effect of AI supply chains in both Taiwan and Japan. In Japan, AI server and high‑performance computing (HPC) demand lifted global IC substrate leader Ibiden, whose shares surged more than 15% intraday, leading a Nikkei rebound. Taiwan’s market, though trading in a high‑range range‑bound manner, saw AI hardware upgrade concept stocks maintain strong momentum, with substrate and copper‑foil board (CCL) groups climbing against the trend, and Lianmao hitting a limit‑up.

Institutional investors note that recent PCB stocks are rising against the tide, indicating capital is shifting from pure AI chip concepts to the broader AI hardware supply chain (such as ABF substrates, PCBs and server equipment). 009828 focuses on the PCB industry leaders in Taiwan, Japan and Korea, with its top ten holdings covering key firms like Unimicron, Ibiden, Taiwan‑Optoelectronics, Nitto Denko, Zhen Ding‑KY, Golden Image, Taiwan‑Yao and Nan‑Dian.

According to the latest research by TPCA and the Industrial Technology Research Institute’s International Production Center, global substrate output is projected to reach $14.75 billion in 2025 (up 18.5% YoY) and to grow further to $19.51 billion in 2026 (up 32.3% YoY) driven by AI servers, high‑speed switches and advanced packaging demand, underscoring a clear long‑term growth trend.

China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB ETF manager Yeh Song‑hsuan said that the PCB industry's business cycle used to be heavily influenced by PC and smartphone demand, but as AI servers become a new growth engine, the market structure is shifting markedly. Because AI servers require PCBs with more layers, higher‑grade materials and a higher unit value than traditional servers, industry growth now stems not only from volume increases but also from value added by upgraded specifications.

Yeh added that, propelled by global tech giants continuously expanding AI data‑center investments, AI development has moved beyond chip design and advanced processes to include ABF substrates, high‑end PCBs and critical materials. As AI applications keep spreading, the related supply chain is expected to benefit continuously from data‑center builds and hardware upgrades, offering notable long‑term growth potential.
